hooks.command: t=; if [ -n "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then set -- "$TOOLU_BIN"; else set -- /opt/homebrew/bin/toolu /usr/local/bin/toolu /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/toolu "$HOME/.local/bin/toolu" "$(command -v toolu 2>/dev/null)"; fi; for c in "$@"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then case $("$c" --hook-protocol 2>/dev/null </dev/null) in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) t=$c; break;; esac; fi; done; if [ -n "$t" ]; then exec "$t" python-quality hook register --event SessionStart --plugin-root "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; fi; if [ -z "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then b=; for c in "$TOOLU_BUN" "$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then b=$c; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$b" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/register.js" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'python-quality plugin: native toolu not found, running the Bun bundle for this transition release - see #425. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu.' >&2; exec "$b" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dist/register.js"; fi; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"python-quality plugin: no usable native toolu - checked TOOLU_BIN, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and PATH. If TOOLU_BIN is set, it must point to a native toolu and is never replaced. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash, or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu. Then restart the session. See docs/install.md."}'; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: if exist "%TOOLU_BUN%" ("%TOOLU_BUN%" "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\hooks\dist\register.js") else (where /q bun& if not errorlevel 1 (bun "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\hooks\dist\register.js") else if exist "%USERPROFILE%\.bun\bin\bun.exe" ("%USERPROFILE%\.bun\bin\bun.exe" "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\hooks\dist\register.js") else (echo {"systemMessage":"python-quality plugin: no usable native toolu - checked TOOLU_BIN, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and PATH. If TOOLU_BIN is set, it must point to a native toolu and is never replaced. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install ^| bash, or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu. Then restart the session. See docs/install.md."}))
